description: Language-neutral golden vectors for Zeptly Registry Protocol v0.2 (zeptly-jcs-v1). jcs/digest/seal expected values are produced and re-verified by the independent stdlib Python implementation (vectors/zeptly_jcs_v1.py); parser and lock vectors are hand-specified and run by each registry's own harness. An implementation is conformant only if it reproduces every vector.

jcs.name: utf16-order-fb01-vs-10000
jcs.note: U+10000 is D800 DC00 in UTF-16 and sorts BEFORE U+FB01; code-point order would reverse them

jcs.name: rfc8785-section-3.2.3-keys
jcs.input: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign","\r":"Carriage Return","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
jcs.output: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

jcs.name: unicode-not-normalised
jcs.note: NFC and NFD spellings stay distinct

jcs.name: line-endings-inside-values-kept
jcs.note: a manifest string value containing CR or LF is not rewritten after parsing

digest.description: artifact digest = sha256(JCS(projection)); projection includes apiVersion, kind, metadata.{id,registry,origin,synthetic}, spec, references, provenance, security.{classification,capabilities}

seal.description: seal = sha256(JCS({registry,id,version,payload})); payload = files matching payloadPatterns with bare-hex SHA-256, ordered by code-point path order. Lifecycle, integrity, promotion, submission, sanitisation report, evaluation results and the manifest are not payload.

parser.description: JSON-compatible YAML subset (Protocol v0.2 section 2). accept: parsing yields exactly `value`. reject: parsing yields no document and a diagnostic with `code` (and `path` when given); a CLI maps this to exit code 2. `text` is UTF-8; `hex` gives raw bytes.

accept.name: yes-no-on-off-are-strings
accept.text:
a: yes
b: no
on: off

lock.description: Resolver/RuntimeLock vectors (Protocol v0.2 section 6). `expect` is a summary of each entry; `fullLock` pins the exact lock shape. Transitive resolution and cycle detection are out of scope.
